subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: token volumes and peak TPS
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@finledger.com>, Samir Shah <samir@finledger.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: token volumes and peak TPS

Hi Olivia / Samir —

Great to chat earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put together a tight hosted-API cost estimate and pilot proposal: 

1) You mentioned the initial integration will be primarily customer-facing chat and a batch summarization job. Can you confirm expected steady-state monthly token volume and any expected spikes (e.g., marketing campaigns, black friday style events)?
2) What's your target/acceptable unit economics? You referenced a monthly budget band on the demo — could you share a $/month range or a target $/1M tokens figure we should aim to hit for a pilot?
3) For sizing the hosted endpoint, can you share expected peak TPS (requests per second) at 95th percentile? We use that to size concurrency / warm pool recommendations.

I've attached the sample usage export you sent earlier (finledger-usage-sample-Q1.csv) so we can anchor volumes. We'll draft 2 options: (A) no-commit hosted pricing (pay-as-you-go) and (B) 3-month pilot with committed tokens + a lower $/1M token tier.

Next steps: if you can reply with the numbers above, we'll aim to get formal pricing & an SOW draft to procurement by end of week.

Thanks —
Rishi
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Attachments: finledger-usage-sample-Q1.csv (csv, 48KB)

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@finledger.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir@finledger.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: token volumes and peak TPS

Thanks Rishi — good recap. A few numbers from our side after syncing with engineering and finance: 

- Expected monthly token volume (steady-state): ~1.2 billion tokens/mo (mostly generation tokens from chat, plus ~200M tokens for batch summarization).
- Peak TPS (95th): ~18 TPS for short spikes; sustained peak during marketing campaigns could hit ~30 TPS for ~10-15 minutes.
- Budget: for a 3-month pilot we'd be comfortable in the $20k–$30k/month range; long-term target is to get unit economics down but procurement wants baseline costs first.

Target $/1M tokens: we don't have a firm internal target, but finance indicated they'd like something near $25–$30 per 1M tokens to be competitive with current vendors. If that pricing requires committed volume, outline what commitment levels would be needed.

Procurement is also asking for an SOW and an estimate to include in the PO. Attaching a short SOW request template they prefer (FinLedger_SOW_request.pdf).

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to talk trade-offs (latency vs cost) for the pilot.

—Olivia
Head of Product, FinLedger
Olivia Chen
Attachments: FinLedger_SOW_request.pdf (1 page)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@finledger.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: token volumes and peak TPS

Olivia — thanks for the clear numbers, that's very helpful. High-level thoughts and options (we'll formalize in a one-pager/SOW):

Option A — Pay-as-you-go (no commit):
- List unit price (small-commit) for the standard LlamaX-8 model: $120 / 1M tokens for generations; embeddings separate.
- For ~1.2B tokens, that price is likely outside your stated budget.

Option B — 3-month pilot with committed tokens (recommended to hit your budget range):
- Example commitment: 1.0B tokens/month committed for 3 months, with an overage rate.
- Discounted unit price target we can approach: $28–$35 / 1M tokens depending on commitment and peak TPS headroom.
- For the peak 30 TPS short spikes, we'll provision burst capacity; sustained >20 TPS would require a larger warm pool or a dedicated route.

Notes on unit economics: the pricing step-downs are primarily driven by committed volume and predictable traffic profile (we can reduce headroom if you accept brief queuing during ultra-short spikes). If you need hard SLOs at 30+ TPS sustained, that pushes towards Dedicated or a higher committed tier.

Next steps for us: Marissa (cc'd) will draft a two-option SOW (pilot commit vs pay-as-you-go) and include precise cost math showing $/1M tokens at each tier + expected monthly invoice for your 1.2B token profile.

Would you prefer the quote to show: (1) price per 1M tokens only, or (2) price + example invoice based on your 1.2B tokens? We can do both.

Best —
Rishi

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: token volumes and peak TPS

Internal — quick note before I send the SOW draft to Olivia: 

Ben, can you confirm margin assumptions if we price at $30 / 1M tokens for a 1.0B committed tier? Also, include an engineering note on what final TPS headroom we can guarantee for hosted (pay-as-you-go) vs committed warm pools. I think we should present: 

- Option 1 (Pilot commit): 1.0B tokens/mo committed, $30 / 1M tokens, 20 TPS sustained with 30 TPS short burst (10 minutes) included. Overage at $45 / 1M.
- Option 2 (No-commit): $120 / 1M tokens, automatic scaling, best-effort headroom (no guaranteed SLO).

Ben — can you draft the exact cost math for the 1.2B token example (line items) so the SOW has a clear expected monthly invoice? I want to be conservative on the burst capacity language so procurement is comfortable.

I'll pull together the SOW and a short appendix on 'how we calculate $/1M tokens' so finance sees the unit economics. Once we have Ben's numbers I'll send to Olivia and procurement.

Marissa
Account Director, Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@finledger.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir@finledger.com>, procurement@finledger.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: token volumes and peak TPS

Thanks Marissa/Rishi — that approach sounds reasonable. Procurement wants the SOW + an example invoice line showing committed price and expected monthly invoice for the 1.2B token baseline.

If you can provide: 
- SOW draft + appendix explaining $/1M token calc
- Example invoice for 1.2B tokens under the 1.0B committed tier (showing committed line + overage math)
- Confirmation that short 30 TPS bursts (<=15 minutes) are covered in the pilot language

We can route the paperwork next week. If possible, include an estimated PO lead time and any required billing contact info.

We'll plan a pilot start on July 20 pending PO — that's our internal timeline.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Olivia
Head of Product, FinLedger
